propositions: Project-specific code-review criteria configured in .rebar/criteria_routing.json merge successfully but never execute, creating a silent failure indistinguishable from a clean rubric.
Code-review runtime must support dynamic fan-in of activated project criteria in round_a step only, replicating the existing plan-review runner pattern without workflow DSL fields or instance state.

Project criterion logical ids (project.<name>) must map to sanitized physical prompt ids (code-review-project-<name>) and resolve assets from the repository snapshot, raising fatal LLMError on missing or malformed configuration.

Code-review Pass 3 must apply repository-effective routing (thresholds, blocking posture, nit-suppression) using only logical criterion ids, independent of model output and without additional LLM invocation.
CLI commands rebar criteria eval and calibrate_criterion must accept activated logical project ids, map them to physical ids, and reject unknown, inactive, or ambiguous dual-gate ids.
Documentation must describe code-review project-criterion runtime resolution, configuration failure handling, and eval entry point in docs/llm-framework.md.
